title: Trait definition
description: A trait's authored definition. Ranges here are the same numbers ContentBounds enforces in the loader; SchemaAgreementTests asserts the two never drift apart.

schema_version.description: Version of this content format (TDD 11.1). Pinned by const so a file authored for a later format is refused by tooling, not read under today's assumptions; ContentSet.SupportedContentSchemaVersion states the same number and SchemaAgreementTests keeps the two equal.

id.description: Stable namespaced identifier; the pattern is ContentId's own format.

display_name_key.description: Localization key, never a player-facing literal (TDD 11.1).

kind.description: An inclination contributes a weighted pull to a decision; a principle closes the decision outright and never carries a weight (spec §3.2).

tag.description: The contract tag this trait reacts to.
